note: Daily shop jobs and the output each one must leave. Paths are relative to --root (the shop work dir). {date} = YYYY-MM-DD in the job's timezone. Read-only config; run_gap_check.py never writes into --root.

jobs.name: muse_pack
jobs.note: pack-D.md is written the morning after D (~11:00 UTC), so today's expected file is yesterday's date

jobs.name: auto_list_state
jobs.note: last_check.json is rewritten each auto-list run; empty *.lock files are flock targets and are normal. Auto-list runs every 15 min inside active_window (PT); outside it, never stale; inside, stale when the later of last run / window start is > max_age_minutes old
